title: Excessive bluetooth pairing requests Pixel 5, latest build
symptom: User reports non-stop Bluetooth pairing requests on Pixel 5 with Dexcom G6 transmitter, logs show errors about needing BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED and 'Pairing failed so removing pairing automation'. Another user with Samsung S9+ also gets Bluetooth connection question every 5 minutes after Samsung update.
cause: The issue is a duplicate of #1494, and the cause is likely incorrect settings related to Android 10 options, as suggested by maintainer tolot27.
fix: Follow the options described in issue #1494 comment (https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1494#issuecomment-728202441). One user confirmed that these options solved the issue.
evidence_quote: thx - these options have solved the issue - https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1494#issuecomment-728202441
